note: Speaker-recognition model for the officer voice check: WeSpeaker ResNet34 trained on VoxCeleb (Apache-2.0), ONNX. Input: 80-band Kaldi fbank (25 ms frames, 10 ms shift, Hamming window, no dither) with the per-utterance mean removed, shape [1, frames, 80]. Output: a 256-value voiceprint, compared by cosine similarity. Pinned by revision and SHA-256; for the pilot, host the file in India. The match threshold is a starting value, to be calibrated on pilot recordings.
